This is an overlap of that specialization, not of the full theories: CharacterTheory also works over nonmodular algebraically closed fields, constructs the class algebra and computational character table, while CompactGroups treats arbitrary compact Hausdorff groups and analytic Hilbert bases.
overlaps.proposal: Keep both general developments.
